proposal.falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Reject every preregistered mutation and emit only the declared bounded software, symbolic, formal, numerical, or structural completion.
proposal.hypothesis: A bounded Raft joint-consensus membership-change control artifact can expose declared obligations while refusing unsupported scientific, operational, identity, or authority promotion.
proposal.novelty_against_880_frozen_proposals: Raft elections appeared in prior work, but no frozen proposal isolates joint-consensus membership change, overlapping majorities, snapshot installation, stale leaders, and evidence credit.
proposal.null_or_failure_condition: The artifact omits a declared Raft joint-consensus membership-change control obligation, accepts a preregistered mutation, erases a negative, or promotes a result beyond its evidence lane.
proposal.rollback_or_recovery: Stop the proposal, retain every failed witness, rewrite no history, and leave external, sibling, participant, production, and authority state unchanged.
proposal.title: Method Flow Raft joint-consensus membership-change, term, log-matching, stale-leader, snapshot-install, cancellation, teardown, and evidence-credit tribunal
